summary: Retest of Master Admin portal-switch buttons after AppRoutes.js DashboardRoute guard fix + MasterAdminPage handler swap. BOTH buttons now route correctly. Global Dashboard button (portal-switch-gymaxis) navigates to /dashboard?as=global and renders the Global cross-gym view (h1='Global Dashboard', tagline 'Cross-gym analytics, documents & management', [data-testid=dashboard-header] present). No bounce-back to /master-admin observed for either button. Bug fully resolved.

critical_code_review_comments: The fix is clean: AppRoutes.js DashboardRoute now recognises both `?as=operator` and `?as=global` as previewDashboard, bypassing the master-admin redirect for either intent. MasterAdminPage.handlePulseFitnessSwitch pushes ?as=global; handlePulseSwitch pushes ?as=operator. DashboardPage.showGlobal correctly renders Global when as!='operator'. All three pieces now agree.

Minor note (not blocking): the shared module tabs area under the header shows 'Your Operations Hub' text in both Global and Operator preview modes — this is expected shared chrome but a future improvement might tailor the sub-hero copy to the previewed intent for extra clarity.

rca of the issue: Previous iteration RCA: guard at AppRoutes.js:253 bounced any master admin whose home org wasn't the operator org back to /master-admin whenever they hit /dashboard, so the Global Dashboard branch in DashboardPage.showGlobal was unreachable. Fix applied by main agent: (a) MasterAdminPage.handlePulseFitnessSwitch now navigates to /dashboard?as=global (explicit intent); (b) DashboardRoute reads previewAsGlobal = (?as=='global') and includes it in previewDashboard so the master-admin bounce-back is skipped when Global is explicitly requested. Verified end-to-end in this iteration: URL settles at /dashboard?as=global and the Global header renders.
